notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds (Total Governmental Funds column, p4); business-type activities are on the accrual basis (proprietary statements p5-7, Total column; the government-wide Statement of Activities p2 also shows business-type activities on the accrual basis, total expenses 2,664,707). Fund balances (3,061,638 / 2,722,284) roll forward; ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents' 2,710,968 (p3; County treasurer cash 12,495 printed separately); beginning cash not printed. The trim holds only the first page of the Statement of Activities (no general revenues / change in net position). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (includes capital assets and debt, so not the funds balance sheet); component units excluded. Business-type: Other revenue 6,561 counted in Charges for Services (Statement of Activities 2,888,759 = sales + other revenue). Water Fund issued capital debt 439,587 (cash flow statement p7); no proceeds line on the accrual operating statement. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (pp13-14, more detailed; the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p8 is not recorded, to avoid double counting); Cemetery department is Public works on the fund statement, categorized health/welfare. Street, Economic Development and Sales Tax funds from their budget schedules (pp9-11); nonmajor Debt Service Fund from the combining statement (p12; Airport Grant and Lottery funds had no activity). Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule; no proprietary detail lines. Read pages 1-14 of 14
